question: Pilocarpine reduce the intraocular pressure in persons with closed angle glaucoma by:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Pilocarpine" -> "contracts iris sphincter muscle" -> "pulls iris away from trabecular meshwork" -> "increases aqueous humor outflow" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Pilocarpine" -> "contracts iris sphincter muscle" -> "increases aqueous humor outflow" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Pilocarpine" -> "increases aqueous humor outflow" -> "reduces intraocular pressure" -> 75%
CHAIN: "Pilocarpine" -> "contracts iris sphincter muscle" -> "reduces intraocular pressure" -> 70%
analysis: Pilocarpine is a muscarinic agonist that primarily works by contracting the ciliary muscle and the iris sphincter muscle. This contraction opens the trabecular meshwork, facilitating increased outflow of aqueous humor from the eye, thereby reducing intraocular pressure. This mechanism is particularly useful in treating closed-angle glaucoma.
